Results.ReviewText: Good, portable grill. Single burner doesn't get as hot as I'd like, but I think I found the problem. I have it hooked to a 20 lb propane tank and next time I will open the tank valve for >1 minute before lighting. Blue looks nice and I also got the stand.
Results.Title: Good grill.

Results.ReviewText: Great little portable grill. Easy to set up and maintain. Cooks well. I followed many of the guidelines outlined on the Weber grill cooking website. All worked well. Replace drill pans often. I also insert a sheet of aluminium foil in the base of the grill and poked a hole for drippings to flow. Helps keep the base of the grill clean. Can replace as often as needed. Great grill. I recommend for small quick meals. We love it.
Results.Title: Weber Q 1200 Review

Results.ReviewText:
The tank valve is right underneath the right handle making it awkward to handle the grill. Also wish the cover had a latch to keep it closed for transporting. 
Easy to clean, and high quality. Warms up fast. Cooks meats, vegetables, and seafood evenly. Lights quickly.
Results.Title: My First Webber

Results.ReviewText: This a great grill for small spaces and easy to use.  My neighbor saw mine and bought one for herself and she is thrilled as well.
Results.Title: Great BBQ

Results.ReviewText: Lit first try. Cooks everything perfectly.Love this grill!
Results.Title: Great bbq

Results.ReviewText: This little grill is just the right size for us.  It seems well made and sturdy.  So far we have used it once to grill chicken and it worked perfectly.
Results.Title: Weber 1200

Results.ReviewText: Great little (big) grill. For just 2 people, the size is great. We plan on using it for our boat and RV too.
Results.Title: Q 1200

Results.ReviewText: In review of this product i can only reference the brand ...Weber ... thoughtfully engineered and constructed.  Been using my Weber Q for a few years several times a week since .  Used in brutal Chicago winters , and at the beach in the summer and lakeside in the fall . In every instance i have had restuarant quality seared chops , steaks , and chicken .  By profession im a HVAC service tech and repair gas appliances often and almost everyone in my service area uses the Weber brand and reinforces my testimony.
Results.Title: Superior Quality

Results.ReviewText: Cooks great and escapes local BBQ ban with size and portability.
Results.Title: Safely Beat the ban

Results.ReviewText:
Best little grill out there! Feels great grilling on it. 

Easy start, even controllable heat, almost zero flare ups, easy to clean. I bought the black one so it does discolor from the grilling. Solid grill so worth the $$$. 

Love it on my apartment deck.I added a grilling table under it and using a 20lb propane bottle with it. One day I'd like to own a larger Q series grill.
Results.Title: Best little grill out there!

Results.ReviewText: I wasn’t sure about this purchase but I am so happy I went with my WeberQ! I love it. Heats quickly and evenly and seems like it’s built to last. Great grill for my boat.
Results.Title: Great grill and cute!

Results.ReviewText: Very well made.  Heats FAST and easy to regulate heat. Perfect size for 1-2 people (and up to four depending on what you are grilling).
Results.Title: Heats FAST and easy to regulate heat

Results.ReviewText: We bought this to go camping with and we so love it!  Easy start is great, and stayed burning even in the wind.  I recommend it
Results.Title: Our new traveling companion.

ClientResponses.Response: Hi, Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback, We're sorry to hear that your new grill arrived with missing grates. We certainly would not expect this and we'd love to have you back up in grilling in no time! We have passed this information to our support team and they will reach out to you shortly. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Results.ReviewText: I purchased a new Weber Q 1200, blue, US/CA/MX	51080001	from Weber on line and it finally arrived.  Upon opening the sealed box I discovered that the cooking grates were missing.  I have been on hold with customer service for over 30 minutes right now and am very frustrated.   I'm hoping I'll love it once I finally receive some grates but am very unhappy with my purchase at this time.
Results.Title: Cooking Grates missing from delivery!!

Results.ReviewText: J'utilise ce barbecue depuis maintenant un mois et je suis très satisfait. Il prend très peu d'espace sur mon petit balcon et malgré sa surface de cuisson restreinte, il est bien performant. Il n'est pas très énergivore puisqu'avec une bombonne de 1 lb, j'ai pu faire 6 fois de la cuisson de viande.
Results.Title: Compact et performant!

Results.ReviewText: This grill is the best!  Easy to assemble, start and clean up.  Food tastes amazing
Results.Title: Grilling is fun again!!!

Results.ReviewText: I Love the grill easy to use warms up quick easy to clean
Results.Title: Love Grill

Results.ReviewText: J’ai fait 2-3 fois des grillades, la cuisson était parfaite
Results.Title: Très compact, conserve sa chaleur

Results.ReviewText: Excellent small grill.  Heats up quickly and cooks evenly.  We have it on our third floor balcony and it is very convenient.
Results.Title: Great small grill for balcony

Results.ReviewText: I find that this grill is perfect for 2 retired people it cook great easy to use, easy to clean and looks great
Results.Title: great grill

Results.ReviewText: Absolutely the best small portable grill you can buy. Even better if you buy the Weber stand for it. Love this grill
Results.Title: The best

Results.ReviewText: I love this Weber grill. It’s the perfect size for my balcony (I live in an apartment). It grills really well and evenly. I love to grill in the summer time and this will be perfect. I’ve had it for 4 weeks and I think I’ve used it at least 10 times.
Results.Title: ❤️ Love ❤️

Results.ReviewText: Really impressed! It’s not that heavy, yet the grates almost cook like our cast iron Weber. You can fit a surprisingly large amount of food on the grill
Results.Title: Perfect Grill for traveling

Results.ReviewText: I haven't yet used this grill enough to fully review it, but I am impressed with the quality construction and features it has. The dome thermometer is very useful and the grill is easy to use, although I am a bit concerned about food or sauces falling on the gas burner and plugging the tiny holes. It lights on first try every time and heats up fast. It is very stable and the side tables are quite handy. I think the split grilling plates will be easy to remove and clean.
Results.Title: Quality construction, clever design

Results.ReviewText: I have always owned Weber Grills...Since I only grill for myself, I chose to purchase a Weber 1200Q..It is just the right size, heats evenly and light weight...not to mention it was the one that is a Special CUBS edition...being a long time CUBS Super Fan, what could be better.  I have only pros for this grill:  light weight, even heat, grills several items, if you choose, easy clean up...I also purchased the stand and this added to my Love of Weber Products.  You cannot go wrong, if  you want a smaller grill that cookls like the Big Weber Grills.
Results.Title: It's a Weber Q...Only the Best when it says Weber.

Results.ReviewText: I bought me a Weber 4 years ago and LOVE it! So easy to use and it's just the two of us and it's perfect. I loved it so much I bought one for my parents and my brother!
Results.Title: I loved it so much I bought two more!

Results.ReviewText: Bought the Q1200 a month ago. Awesome grill. I bought the rolling stand along with it. It can go anywhere we go! Love it!!!
Results.Title: Awesomness!!

Results.ReviewText:
Love this grill, power of a full size grill packed in a small package. Cooks very evenly, easy to clean.

5 stars
Results.Title: Best grill

Results.ReviewText: I’d been looking at this for a while and finally bit the bullet. So glad I did. It was very easy to setup. And was able to start using it within an hour. It is the perfect size for my family of 3. My husband and I are not grilling people, but it’s nice to be able to cook outside and not make a mess in the kitchen. It’s cooked everything perfectly. And I love the Weber app to help guide me through the process. I also chose this one because it’s portable for when we go up to the lake cabins. Great value!
Results.Title: Perfect for my small family!

Results.ReviewText: Only grill I like had one before a big move and had to get the same one that’s how much I like it!!
Results.Title: Barbecue review

Results.ReviewText: I have been a Weber charcoal kettle guy for about 30 years, and still am but as we're going on an RV road trip and staying for a month at a park that doesn't allow charcoal or wood campfires, we decided on the Weber Q1200 and glad we did. Bought a long propane hose with adapter for the Q's fitting to run off our 20 gal. tank. Works great, food cooks fast, tastes and looks good! Will leave the Smokey Joe at home this particular trip
Results.Title: Perfect Propane Substitute for RVing

Results.ReviewText: We got out Weber Q 6 years ago. And it is going strong. About 2years in the Electric igniter went out but that’s no big deal. Surprise it made it that long. But the rest fo the grill is going strong. We take it everywhere. Camping, family cookouts, and stays on the back desk all year long. Because we use it all year long. I got a accessory propane hose to Connect to the larger tank. I just took it all apart and ran it through the dishwasher. Then  armor all the hard plastic and the metal parts i sprayed with cooking spray to re-season. Looks like I can get another 6 year. IT COOKS LIKE A NEW ONE. no hot or cold spots. Well worth the money.  KEEP MAKING LIKE THIS.  It’s hard to find a well made product any more. This grill is made to last if taking care of.
Results.Title: LOVE OUR Q

Results.ReviewText: Perfect for pontoon boat. Doesn’t get hot underneath BBQ. Very well built no flair ups so far.
Results.Title: Perfect

Results.ReviewText: Nice grill.  Great size for what I need.  Easy to move around.  Very versatile.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Honestly it is the best gas grill you can get if your looking for something small and that gets the job done. I bought this grill for my family (family of 4) and it is the perfect size, doesn’t take up much space at home, can be easily stored, fits perfectly in our Nissan Rogue, it’s easy to carry and lightweight. My wife loves to cook in it. We use it for just about any sort of cooking and food. Grill sits at home connected to a 20 lb. propane tank and when we head out to the beach or lake we take 2 1lb. propane tank. Definitely recommend it to everyone that’s looking for a gas grill. This Weber grill is the best choice when it comes to gas grills.
Results.Title: Overall Grill

Results.ReviewText: The Q1200 is an amazing grill. We love it!! Highly recommend it!!
Results.Title: Weber Q1200 grille is an amazing product!!

Results.ReviewText: It is a weber so it is a great product. I Own six different weber grills for years now.
Results.Title: weber

ClientResponses.Response: Hi, We are sorry to hear you are having issues with the igniter kit. We have reached out to you via email to see if you are still covered under warranty. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: have had grill now for just over two years.  the igniter stopped working within six months. I was informed by Lowes that it was a warranty item.  I can not find info on weber site to get replacement parts.
Results.Title: battery igniter  is of poor quality.

ClientResponses.Response: Hi, We are sorry you had missing parts. We are trying our best to get back to our customers as soon as possible. We did notice the request and we already sent your missing part. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: The grill is great, size is perfect, portable and really efficient. However, the grill came with missing parts. My request for the “start” igniter was ignored. I have to use a match to start my grill.
Results.Title: Missing igniter.

Results.ReviewText: Fairly small  The one burner isn’t easily regulated to keep grilling temperature at a med. to low level. I can turn the temperature to it’s lowest temperature, I still get a grilling temp in excess of 350 degrees. I have to raise the lid for a few minutes to reduce the temperature; several times during the grilling cycle... in order to keep the meet from getting to hot and burning.
Results.Title: Grilling issues

ClientResponses.Response: Hello, thank you for taking your time to submit your review! Our sincerest apologies on the delay! With increased at-home dining we are experiencing higher than normal summer volume this year. However it seems like you were able to get in touch with our support team and place an order for your replacement part under warranty. Please do not hesitate to reach back to us if you have any further questions or need assistance. We will be happy to help! Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: WeberGrills

Results.ReviewText: I bought this in January and it worked great for 4 months and now the gas won’t work. Brand new bottle of gas worked fine one day not the next. I called Weber and waited on hold for 2 hours and no one ever picked up. Left my phone number 4 days ago and they have yet to call me back. Emailed them and all I got was emails trying to get me to upgrade I thought Weber was a better company than this.
Results.Title: Q1200

Results.ReviewText:
I live in NYC.  Perfect for a NY city balcony.   If there is a lot of wind, be mindful it will take a long time for the burner to get really hot!   In cooler temps it does take a while.
Been using it every day and I totally love it.  Best part is you can take the black grill and clean it in the kitchen sink.   I will be taking this camping to test, but for NYC looking to do more grilling this is perfect.  You can fit a lot on this small grill you just need to make room.
Results.Title: NYC Grill  perfect size

Results.ReviewText: Have only used it twice but am completely happy with it.  Look forward to many great cooking experiences.
Results.Title: Great Product

Results.ReviewText: Picked up this grill four camping in our teardrop trailer.  It's the perfect little grill that cooks like our full size Weber Genesis grill.  I love the fold out wings, they provide a great place to hold a plate or the cooking utensils that I'm using.  Looking forward to many meals cooked on this little guy.
Results.Title: Perfect for us.

Results.ReviewText: Great product....high quality and easy to use! Perfect for two people living in an apartment.
Results.Title: Great Value

Results.ReviewText: Perfect size for my husband and I. Easy to cook on and also cleanup is great
Results.Title: Perfect Size

Results.ReviewText: I needed a new portable grill for camping.  The q1200 was recommended by many on a Camping FaceBook group that I belong to.  So far it has worked great.  Heats up quick and has fairly even heat.  It is easy to keep clean.  I would recommend this grill to anyone.
Results.Title: Q1200 first impressions

Results.ReviewText: This is a replacement for a Weber Grill that was broken in a move. I lived without one for a year and just couldn't take it anymore. Soooooooooooo glad I got another
Results.Title: Couldn't Live Without One

Results.ReviewText: Awesome little grill for on the go, we use this every where from, camping, tailgating and the marina when hanging at the boat for the weekend.
Results.Title: Q1200

Results.ReviewText: High quality construction and design. Perfect for individuals and small families who don’t want or have the space for a full size grill.  We use it on our balcony.
Results.Title: SMALL grill with BIG results.

ClientResponses.Response: Hello, thank you for taking your time to submit your review with us! We are very sorry to hear about this issue and the delay from our support team!  We are experiencing higher volumes of questions from our grilling community as many are enjoying more at-home dining during Covid-19. We have passed your feedback to our support team and they just reached back via email. We hope to help you find a solution soon! Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: WeberGrills

Results.ReviewText:
My rating would be 5 stars as this grill is perfect for cooking a steak or burger. Only problem is, even at the lowest setting the temperature is over 400 deg. This is a problem for cooking chicken. 
I emailed customer service about this but never heard back.
Results.Title: Good for high temperature cooking.

Results.ReviewText: It cooks fast, it's easy to operate and I don't know about those it say it blows out in the wind !  We've had some pretty strong winds and it's never blown out.  I think it's the best grill we have had ! It may be a little more pricey but what's more pricey is a grill that doesn't work !  But this one sure does. cook good !
Results.Title: Light, looks really good,Cooks great
